*followed by massive spam*
LOL LEAVING SO SOON
STAY
WE WANT YOU!!

so I wrote in game chat uhmmm wtfs going on?
somebody wrote "YOUR BRAIN IS DIEING"
I tried to join a different server and the spam comes back, iLL-ViZi0N tried to join another server!!!!!

So I'm pretty pissed off/confused at this point and i hit cntrl alt delete and my mouse is stuck in the top left corner of my screen and i can't move it wtf!!! and the musics still playing. I ended up having to restart my computer, those japanese beat me :O
Anyone else join this server or something like this?
